title: Growing Up in the 50s and 60s
subtitle: 80 Easy Large Print Word Searches with School Days, Neighborhood Memories, Family Traditions, and Readable Solutions
topic: American Childhood and Neighborhood Life, 1950s and 1960s
welcome:
These puzzles explore familiar school, neighborhood, home, and community details associated with growing up in the United States during the 1950s and 1960s. No two childhoods were alike, and no particular memory is expected.

Each page has twelve words and one optional prompt. You can think of your own experience, imagine a different one, or skip the question and enjoy the puzzle.
closing: Some details may have felt familiar, while others may have been new. Childhood took many forms in every decade. Thank you for bringing your own perspective to these word searches.

sections.reflection: Imagine a classroom that would be comfortable for learning today. What would you put in it?
sections.closing_reflection: Which school subject would you choose to explore for an afternoon?
